title: A different user signing in on the same browser inherits the saved view
preconds:
1. User 1 has saved a clearly non-default view on this browser (e.g. Type = Special Order, Last Quarter).
2. User 2 can open the report..
steps:
1. Sign out user 1 and sign in user 2 on the SAME browser.
2. Open the Parts Velocity report.
expected:
1. User 2 sees user 1's saved view (Type = Special Order, Last Quarter, the saved columns and sort).
2. This is by design: storage is per browser, not tied to the account - there is no per-account separation.

---
This is the expected behaviour as per epic SV-8582, read on 17 August 2026, and the Parts Velocity report specification version 11 (S4-R6), read on 17 August 2026.
Last checked against build v3.8-d0e135e on 8/19/2026.
Re-checked against the live specification on 26 August 2026: the requirements this case cites are unchanged, so only the version cited above was updated.
